s: Today we are talking about work and careers.
Almost everyone works, or will work one day, so these words are really useful.
We picked seven useful words for today's lesson: freelance, benefit, paycheck, training, employee, report, and career.
When you work freelance, you work for yourself.
You do short jobs for different clients instead of working for one company.
My friend Sara works freelance as a graphic designer.
She has three or four clients at the same time.
You choose your own hours and your own projects.
It does, but freelance life is not always easy.
Some months are very busy, and some months are quiet.
So a freelance worker has to plan carefully.
And a freelance worker also has to find new clients all the time.
When you work for a company, the work comes to you.
When you work freelance, you have to look for it.
But many people still choose freelance work because freedom is worth it.
They can travel, they can rest, and nobody tells them what to wear.
That last one is a big benefit for me.

A benefit is something good you get from a job.
Free lunch, health insurance, and extra days off are all benefits.
Benefits matter a lot when people choose a job.
Sometimes a job with a smaller salary but better benefits is the smarter choice.
My brother took a job because one benefit was working from home two days a week.
That benefit saved him hours of travel every single day.
Every company offers different benefits, so it is smart to ask about benefits in a job interview.
Write down the benefits before you say yes to any job.
Let me tell you about my friend's company.
They give every worker a free lunch, a gym membership, and a free language course.
That is a package of benefits that keeps people happy.
When the benefits are good, people stay longer and work harder.
Your paycheck is the money you receive for your work.
Most people get a paycheck every month.
And a paycheck can feel very different depending on the job.
My first paycheck was small, but I was so proud of it.
I spent the whole paycheck in one weekend, which was not smart at all.
The smart move is to save part of every paycheck.
Even a small part of each paycheck grows over time, and your future self will thank you.
A paycheck is not just money, it is a reward for your hard work.
When the paycheck arrives, it feels like a small celebration.
Training is the learning you do to get the skills for a job.
New employees usually get some training when they start.
The training at my first job took two weeks.
Good training makes a new job much less stressful.
Companies offer training all year, because new skills help every employee do better work.
The best training is the kind you use every single day.
Let me give you an example.
My cousin started a job at a hotel.
Every morning, the older workers showed him what to do.
By the end of the month, he could do everything alone.
That is what good training looks like.
Without that training, his first month would have been a disaster.
Training is really a gift from the company to the new worker.
And here is a tip for our listeners: when you start a new job, ask lots of questions during the training.
The trainers are there to help you, and good questions show that you care.

An employee is a person who works for a company.
If you have a job, you are an employee.
A happy employee does better work.
Smart companies take care of their employees with fair pay and good benefits.
The company where my cousin works has two hundred employees.
Every new employee gets a friendly welcome on the first day.
When an employee feels respected, the whole team works better.
A report is a written document about work that has been done.
Managers often ask for a weekly report.
Writing a good report is a useful skill.
My manager read my report and said it was clear and short, which is exactly what a report should be.
A clear report saves everyone time.
The report should show the facts, the results, and what to do next.
Even a short report can change a big decision.
Our last word today is career.
Your career is the series of jobs you do in your life.
It is the big picture of your working life.
My uncle started his career as a taxi driver, and twenty years later he owns a small company.
A career can change in amazing ways.
A good career takes time to build.
Every job teaches you something that helps your career grow.
And every career starts with a first step.
Even a small job can be the start of a great career.
Let's review today's words one more time.
Freelance means working for yourself with different clients.
A benefit is something good you get from a job.
Your paycheck is the money you earn.
An employee works for a company.
A report is a written document about work.
And your career is your working life over time.
Try to use them today in real sentences.
Thanks for listening to Muse English!
See you tomorrow for more words.
